name: Update Generated Docs
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      prompt:
        description: "Prompt for Claude Code"
        required: true
        default: "Update generated documentation"

jobs:
  update-docs:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.MZ_BOT_GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      
      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          override: true
      
      - name: Run Claude Code Action
        uses: materializeinc/claude-code-action@main
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.MZ_BOT_GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          prompt: ${{ github.event.inputs.prompt }}
